summary: Skratch previews the upcoming Season 9 update titled 'The Undertow Approaches' for Dragonheir: Silent Gods. The season introduces a new region called Duskport with new storyline quests and map exploration. A reworked PvP game mode called Glory Colosseum is arriving, combining multi-team arena battles with a dedicated shop for gear and heroes. The preview also reveals new season boss encounters in the Continental Challenge and a new battle pass skin for Saverio.
